firebase         11.0.2   Apache-2.0   firebase/firebase-spark.mjs, 2026-11-11
  The one file here that is not a package's own build: esbuild 0.24.0 bundled
  firebase/app, firebase/auth and firebase/firestore/lite from the npm package into
  one ES module (entry.js beside it is the whole input), so nothing loads from gstatic.
    npx esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --legal-comments=eof
